nodes.name: PROJECT.md
nodes.summary: Project charter for the PMS frontend: defines the goal of completing a modular React/TypeScript property management system for homestay/resort operators, its tech stack (React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Flowbite, Axios), constraints around existing microservice APIs, and lessons learned from prior work on invoices, reservations, and orders.

nodes.name: REQUIREMENTS.md
nodes.summary: Functional and non-functional requirements for the PMS improvement effort, covering order-invoice integration, tour management persistence, dynamic room maps, advanced filtering, user stories, and success criteria for verifying completion.

nodes.name: ROADMAP.md
nodes.summary: Phased delivery roadmap for the PMS improvement project, tracking completed phases (foundation/refactoring, config caching, feature persistence, dynamic room integration, room/invoice map optimization), the current phase (advanced UX & optimization), and future phases like a mobile companion app and reporting dashboard.

nodes.name: STATE.md
nodes.summary: Living project-state log tracking the current roadmap phase, recent completed quick tasks and phase work (e.g. rate-plan menu fix, TLS config, room API refactor, ID-based room mapping), and pending tasks for the PMS project.
